name: 3-hydroxybutyryl-CoA dehydrogenase.
reaction: (3S)-3-hydroxybutanoyl-CoA + NADP(+) = acetoacetyl-CoA + NADPH + H(+).

name: alcohol dehydrogenase (NADP(+)).
reaction: a primary alcohol + NADP(+) = an aldehyde + NADPH + H(+).

name: (S)-malate dehydrogenase (NAD(+), oxaloacetate-forming).
reaction: (S)-malate + NAD(+) = oxaloacetate + NADH + H(+).

name: methylmalonate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase (CoA acylating).
reaction: 2-methyl-3-oxopropanoate + NAD(+) + CoA + H2O = propanoyl-CoA + hydrogencarbonate + NADH + H(+).

name: propanal dehydrogenase (CoA-propanoylating).
reaction: propanal + NAD(+) + CoA = propanoyl-CoA + NADH + H(+).

name: pyruvate synthase.
reaction: 2 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + pyruvate + CoA = 2 reduced [2Fe-2S]- [ferredoxin] + acetyl-CoA + CO2 + H(+).

name: anaerobic carbon-monoxide dehydrogenase.
reaction: CO + 2 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + H2O = 2 reduced [2Fe-2S]- [ferredoxin] + CO2 + 2 H(+).

name: 2-enoate reductase.
reaction: butanoate + NAD(+) = (2E)-2-butenoate + NADH + H(+).

name: trans-2-enoyl-CoA reductase (NAD(+)).
reaction: a 2,3-saturated acyl-CoA + NAD(+) = a (2E)-enoyl-CoA + NADH + H(+).

name: fumarate reductase (NADH).
reaction: succinate + NAD(+) = fumarate + NADH + H(+).

name: acryloyl-CoA reductase (NADH).
reaction: propanoyl-CoA + NAD(+) = acryloyl-CoA + NADH + H(+).

name: short-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase.
reaction: a short-chain 2,3-saturated fatty acyl-CoA + oxidized [electron-transfer flavoprotein] + H(+) = a short-chain (2E)-enoyl-CoA + reduced [electron- transfer flavoprotein].

name: methylmalonyl-CoA carboxytransferase.
reaction: (S)-methylmalonyl-CoA + pyruvate = propanoyl-CoA + oxaloacetate.

name: acetyl-CoA C-acyltransferase.
reaction: an acyl-CoA + acetyl-CoA = a 3-oxoacyl-CoA + CoA.

name: phosphate butyryltransferase.
reaction: butanoyl-CoA + phosphate = butanoyl phosphate + CoA.

name: phosphate propanoyltransferase.
reaction: propanoyl-CoA + phosphate = propanoyl phosphate + CoA.

name: phosphate acetyltransferase.
reaction: acetyl-CoA + phosphate = acetyl phosphate + CoA.

name: acetyl-CoA C-acetyltransferase.
reaction: 2 acetyl-CoA = acetoacetyl-CoA + CoA.

name: 1,3-beta-galactosyl-N-acetylhexosamine phosphorylase.
reaction: beta-D-galactosyl-(1->3)-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + phosphate = alpha-D- galactose 1-phosphate + N-acetyl-D-glucosamine.

name: acetate kinase.
reaction: acetate + ATP = acetyl phosphate + ADP.

name: propionate kinase.
reaction: propanoate + ATP = propanoyl phosphate + ADP.

name: butyrate kinase.
reaction: butanoate + ATP = butanoyl phosphate + ADP.

name: propionate CoA-transferase.
reaction: propanoate + acetyl-CoA = propanoyl-CoA + acetate.

name: acetate CoA-transferase.
reaction: an acyl-CoA + acetate = a carboxylate + acetyl-CoA.

name: sialate O-acetylesterase.
reaction: (1) N-acetyl-9-O-acetylneuraminate + H2O = N-acetylneuraminate + acetate + H(+). (2) N-acetyl-4-O-acetylneuraminate + H2O = N-acetylneuraminate + acetate + H(+).

name: alpha-amylase.
reaction: Endohydrolysis of (1->4)-alpha-D-glucosidic linkages in polysaccharides containing three or more (1->4)-alpha-linked D-glucose units.

name: oligo-1,6-glucosidase.
reaction: (1) Hydrolysis of (1->6)-alpha-D-glucosidic linkages in some oligosaccharides produced from starch and glycogen by alpha-amylase, and in isomaltose. (2) isomaltose + H2O = alpha-D-glucose + D-glucose.

name: 1,3-alpha-L-fucosidase.
reaction: Hydrolysis of (1->3)-linkages between alpha-L-fucose and N-acetylglucosamine residues in glycoproteins.

name: 1,6-alpha-L-fucosidase.
reaction: Hydrolysis of (1->6)-linkages between alpha-L-fucose and N-acetyl-D- glucosamine in glycopeptides such as immunoglobulin G glycopeptide and fucosyl-asialo-agalacto-fetuin.

name: endo-alpha-sialidase.
reaction: Endohydrolysis of (2->8)-alpha-sialosyl linkages in oligo- or poly(sialic) acids.

name: lacto-N-biosidase.
reaction: beta-D-Gal-(1->3)-beta-D-GlcNAc-(1->3)-beta-D-Gal-(1->4)-D-Glc + H2O = beta-D-galactosyl-(1->3)-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + lactose.

name: endo-polygalacturonase.
reaction: (1,4-alpha-D-galacturonosyl)n+m + H2O = (1,4-alpha-D-galacturonosyl)n + (1,4-alpha-D-galacturonosyl)m.

name: rhamnogalacturonan hydrolase.
reaction: Endohydrolysis of alpha-D-GalA-(1->2)-alpha-L-Rha glycosidic bond in the rhamnogalacturonan I backbone with initial inversion of anomeric configuration releasing oligosaccharides with beta-D-GalA at the reducing end.

name: exo-alpha-sialidase.
reaction: Hydrolysis of alpha-(2->3)-, alpha-(2->6)-, alpha-(2->8)- glycosidic linkages of terminal sialic acid residues in oligosaccharides, glycoproteins, glycolipids, colominic acid and synthetic substrates.

name: alpha-glucosidase.
reaction: Hydrolysis of terminal, non-reducing (1->4)-linked alpha-D-glucose residues with release of alpha-D-glucose.

name: beta-glucosidase.
reaction: Hydrolysis of terminal, non-reducing beta-D-glucosyl residues with release of beta-D-glucose.

name: alpha-galactosidase.
reaction: Hydrolysis of terminal, non-reducing alpha-D-galactose residues in alpha- D-galactosides, including galactose oligosaccharides, galactomannans and galactolipids.

name: beta-galactosidase.
reaction: Hydrolysis of terminal non-reducing beta-D-galactose residues in beta-D- galactosides.

name: beta-mannosidase.
reaction: Hydrolysis of terminal, non-reducing beta-D-mannose residues in beta-D- mannosides.

name: beta-fructofuranosidase.
reaction: Hydrolysis of terminal non-reducing beta-D-fructofuranoside residues in beta-D-fructofuranosides.

name: glucan 1,4-alpha-glucosidase.
reaction: Hydrolysis of terminal (1->4)-linked alpha-D-glucose residues successively from non-reducing ends of the chains with release of beta-D- glucose.

name: xylan 1,4-beta-xylosidase.
reaction: Hydrolysis of (1->4)-beta-D-xylans, to remove successive D-xylose residues from the non-reducing termini.

name: beta-D-fucosidase.
reaction: Hydrolysis of terminal non-reducing beta-D-fucose residues in beta-D- fucosides.

name: glucan endo-1,3-beta-D-glucosidase.
reaction: Hydrolysis of (1->3)-beta-D-glucosidic linkages in (1->3)-beta-D-glucans.

name: cellulase.
reaction: Endohydrolysis of (1->4)-beta-D-glucosidic linkages in cellulose, lichenin and cereal beta-D-glucans.

name: alpha-L-rhamnosidase.
reaction: Hydrolysis of terminal non-reducing alpha-L-rhamnose residues in alpha-L- rhamnosides.

name: alpha-N-acetylglucosaminidase.
reaction: Hydrolysis of terminal non-reducing N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues in N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosaminides.

name: alpha-L-fucosidase.
reaction: an alpha-L-fucoside + H2O = L-fucose + an alcohol.

name: beta-N-acetylhexosaminidase.
reaction: Hydrolysis of terminal non-reducing N-acetyl-D-hexosamine residues in N-acetyl-beta-D-hexosaminides.

name: non-reducing end alpha-L-arabinofuranosidase.
reaction: Hydrolysis of terminal non-reducing alpha-L-arabinofuranoside residues in alpha-L-arabinosides.

name: endo-1,3(4)-beta-glucanase.
reaction: Endohydrolysis of (1->3)- or (1->4)-linkages in beta-D-glucans when the glucose residue whose reducing group is involved in the linkage to be hydrolyzed is itself substituted at C-3.

name: 1,2-alpha-L-fucosidase.
reaction: methyl-2-alpha-L-fucopyranosyl-beta-D-galactoside + H2O = methyl beta-D- galactoside + L-fucose.

name: galacturonan 1,4-alpha-galacturonidase.
reaction: [(1->4)-alpha-D-galacturonosyl](n) + H2O = alpha-D-galacturonate + [(1->4)-alpha-D-galacturonosyl](n-1).

name: glucan 1,4-beta-glucosidase.
reaction: Hydrolysis of (1->4)-linkages in (1->4)-beta-D-glucans, to remove successive glucose units.

name: mannan endo-1,4-beta-mannosidase.
reaction: Random hydrolysis of (1->4)-beta-D-mannosidic linkages in mannans, galactomannans and glucomannans.

name: endo-1,4-beta-xylanase.
reaction: Endohydrolysis of (1->4)-beta-D-xylosidic linkages in xylans.

name: fructan beta-fructosidase.
reaction: Hydrolysis of terminal, non-reducing (2->1)- and (2->6)-linked beta-D- fructofuranose residues in fructans.

name: exo-poly-alpha-digalacturonosidase.
reaction: [(1->4)-alpha-D-galacturonosyl](n) + H2O = alpha-D-galacturonosyl-(1->4)- D-galacturonate + [(1->4)-alpha-D-galacturonosyl](n-2).

name: 6-phospho-beta-galactosidase.
reaction: a 6-phospho-beta-D-galactoside + H2O = D-galactose 6-phosphate + an alcohol.

name: arabinan endo-1,5-alpha-L-arabinosidase.
reaction: Endohydrolysis of (1->5)-alpha-arabinofuranosidic linkages in (1->5)- arabinans.

name: fumarate hydratase.
reaction: (S)-malate = fumarate + H2O.

name: propanediol dehydratase.
reaction: propane-1,2-diol = propanal + H2O.

name: lactoyl-CoA dehydratase.
reaction: (R)-lactoyl-CoA = acryloyl-CoA + H2O.

name: 3-hydroxybutyryl-CoA dehydratase.
reaction: (3R)-3-hydroxybutanoyl-CoA = (2E)-butenoyl-CoA + H2O.

name: pectin lyase.
reaction: Eliminative cleavage of (1->4)-alpha-D-galacturonan methyl ester to give oligosaccharides with 4-deoxy-6-O-methyl-alpha-D-galact-4-enuronosyl groups at their non-reducing ends.

name: anhydrosialidase.
reaction: Elimination of alpha-sialyl groups in N-acetylneuraminic acid glycosides, releasing 2,7-anhydro-alpha-N-acetylneuraminate.

name: pectate lyase.
reaction: Eliminative cleavage of (1->4)-alpha-D-galacturonan to give oligosaccharides with 4-deoxy-alpha-D-galact-4-enuronosyl groups at their non-reducing ends.

name: rhamnogalacturonan endolyase.
reaction: Endotype eliminative cleavage of L-alpha-rhamnopyranosyl-(1->4)-alpha-D- galactopyranosyluronic acid bonds of rhamnogalacturonan I domains in ramified hairy regions of pectin leaving L-rhamnopyranose at the reducing end and 4-deoxy-4,5-unsaturated D-galactopyranosyluronic acid at the non- reducing end.

name: rhamnogalacturonan exolyase.
reaction: Exotype eliminative cleavage of alpha-L-rhamnopyranosyl-(1->4)-alpha-D- galactopyranosyluronic acid bonds of rhamnogalacturonan I oligosaccharides containing alpha-L-rhamnopyranose at the reducing end and 4-deoxy-4,5-unsaturated D-galactopyranosyluronic acid at the non- reducing end. The products are the disaccharide 2-O-(4-deoxy-beta-L- threo-hex-4-enopyranuronosyl)-alpha-L-rhamnopyranose and the shortened rhamnogalacturonan oligosaccharide containing one 4-deoxy-4,5-unsaturated D-galactopyranosyluronic acid at the non-reducing end.

name: methylmalonyl-CoA mutase.
reaction: (R)-methylmalonyl-CoA = succinyl-CoA.

name: pyruvate carboxylase.
reaction: hydrogencarbonate + pyruvate + ATP = oxaloacetate + ADP + phosphate + H(+).

name: propionyl-CoA carboxylase.
reaction: propanoyl-CoA + hydrogencarbonate + ATP = (S)-methylmalonyl-CoA + ADP + phosphate + H(+).

name: (S)-methylmalonyl-CoA decarboxylase (sodium-transporting).
reaction: (S)-methylmalonyl-CoA + Na(+)(in) + H(+)(out) = propanoyl-CoA + Na(+)(out) + CO2.
